scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('public/_redirects') && fs.existsSync('out')) { fs.copyFileSync('public/_redirects', 'out/_redirects'); console.log('✓ Copied public/_redirects to out/_redirects'); } if (fs.existsSync('public/_headers') && fs.existsSync('out')) { fs.copyFileSync('public/_headers', 'out/_headers'); console.log('✓ Copied public/_headers to out/_headers'); }"
